name: io.github.tjsdyy/musvideo
title: MusVideo
description: Create music videos from songs with story approval, credit confirmation, rendering and progress.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the MusVideo account connected to this chat (name and email). Use it when the user asks which account is connected.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Returns how many credits remain in the connected MusVideo account. Credits cannot be bought or added from ChatGPT; if the user asks how to get more, say they can't be added here, without links, plans or prices. Do not advise whether or when to change subscriptions, including waiting or changing them later. Do not infer subscriptions, renewal dates, refills or future credit grants.

tools.name: import_song
tools.description: Imports a song to use for a music video: either an audio file the user attached in ChatGPT (`file`) or a public link (`audioUrl`: a direct MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/OGG link or a public Suno song page). Exactly one of the two. Limits: up to 50 MB, longer than 5 seconds and at most 10 minutes. YouTube links are not supported. Copies the audio into the user's MusVideo storage; costs no credits. Returns a songId for create_mv_project. Only import music the user has the right to use.

audioUrl.description: Public https link to an audio file or a public Suno song page.

tools.name: create_mv_project
tools.description: Creates a MusVideo project from an imported song and starts listening to the song and drafting a story for the video. Costs 6 credits (song analysis and story). Spends credits from the user's MusVideo account: before calling, tell the user the cost and get explicit confirmation in the chat. Story preparation runs in the background for a few minutes; afterwards call get_mv_progress to show the story and ask the user to approve it. Pass a fresh requestId; calling again with the same requestId returns the same project instead of a duplicate, while calling without one may create a duplicate project. MusVideo does not create sexual or adult content, content that sexualizes or targets minors, or videos depicting real public figures or celebrities; decline those requests instead of calling this tool.

stylePrompt.description: The look, mood, setting or story idea the user wants, in their words.

requestId.description: Unique id for this request, reused on retries.

tools.name: get_mv_progress
tools.description: Shows where a MusVideo project is: preparing the story, story waiting for approval (includes the story text), creating the storyboard, storyboard ready, rendering (percent and finished scene thumbnails), needs credits, failed, or completed (video link). Read-only.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

tools.name: approve_story
tools.description: Approves the story MusVideo proposed for a project (optionally with the user's notes) and starts building the storyboard of scenes. No extra credits: the story fee was charged by create_mv_project. Only call after the user has seen the story and said it is fine. Takes a few minutes; then call get_mv_progress.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

feedback.description: Optional changes the user asked for.

tools.name: quote_mv_render
tools.description: Estimates how many credits it costs to render the whole video from the storyboard (character images, scene images, scene videos and final assembly), and whether the account has enough. Charges nothing and changes nothing. The quote is valid for 15 minutes. Tell the user the number of credits and ask for confirmation before calling start_mv_render.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

tools.name: start_mv_render
tools.description: Starts rendering the whole music video for a quote from quote_mv_render: character images, scene images, scene videos and the final cut, continuing automatically in the background (usually 20–60 minutes). Spends credits from the user's MusVideo account: before calling, tell the user the cost and get explicit confirmation in the chat. The amount is the quote's totalCredits, charged stage by stage; failed items are refunded. Retrying with the same quoteId returns the same render and never charges twice.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

tools.name: cancel_mv_render
tools.description: Stops a render started with start_mv_render. Items that have not started are not charged (queued items are refunded); scenes already finished are kept, and items already being generated may still finish. Confirm with the user before cancelling.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: Lists the music video projects in the connected MusVideo account, newest first, with status, thumbnail and video link when finished. Read-only.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Gets one music video with its playable video link, poster image and watch page, and shows a player. Read-only.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.
